evidence.quote: Middle Horizon, the area of Huaraz was conquered by the Wari culture, this empire built the archaeological rests of Wilcahuain and Waullac

evidence.reasoning: The English Wikipedia article on Huaraz, a separate article from the short one on the site, places the Wari construction of Wilcahuain in the Middle Horizon. The Spanish Wikipedia article on Huilcahuaín adds that excavations of 2005 and 2007 at the Ichic Willkahuaín funerary group beside it dated it to about AD 700 and that the main building was in use until probably the 9th century, with Wari control collapsing at the end of the 8th century; the English stub's 'possibly built ca. 1100 AD' is unreferenced and lies after the end of the Wari Middle Horizon, so the start sits in the Middle Horizon band (500-1000 AD), not at 1100. The sources do not agree on an exact year (the site may even descend from an earlier Recuay centre), so the period name, not a year, is given.
